AI sales assistant for website, Instagram and Telegram

Finds the right product from a customer's question, quotes the price, books the order or meeting and logs it in your CRM. An MVP in 4–6 weeks, from UZS 48 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • One or two channels
  • Answers from your catalogue and price list
  • Lead qualification questions

  • All channels (website chat, Instagram Direct, Telegram, WhatsApp if you use it)
